I am a fourth-year PhD student in the Department of Economics at the University of Washington. My research is in development economics, focused on human capital formation in Solukhumbu, Nepal, where I study how teacher capacity, not just access to technology, shapes whether educational interventions actually work. My dissertation combines a staggered difference-in-differences design with an original cluster-randomized trial of a phone-based teacher support tool.
